Alphapointe
resources.mission: Alphapointe is a nonprofit organization dedicated to empowering people with vision loss by providing employment opportunities, job training, and rehabilitation services. We are one of the largest employers of people who are blind and visually impaired in the U.S. We combine comprehensive rehabilitation services, advocacy, and community involvement to help people achieve independence and success in the workplace and home. Our mission is to empower people with vision loss to achieve their goals and aspirations. One of the most important ways we serve those with vision loss is to help them understand that sight loss isn't a barrier to potential. We use our mission and vision as guides to lead us forward, to make sure every decision, every action, and every move meets our end goal of serving those with vision loss to the best of our abilities.

resources.name: Friends of Maple Grove Cemetery inc .
resources.address: 127-15 Kew Gardens Road, Kew Gardens, NY 11415
resources.mission: Established in 2005, the Friends of Maple Grove, Inc. is a nonprofit membership organization dedicated to supporting and enriching the operations of Maple Grove Cemetery in Kew Gardens, Queens. Our mission is to honor, memorialize, and celebrate life while fostering appreciation of the cemetery's artistic, historical, horticultural, and cultural treasures. Guided by our motto, "Where History Comes Alive," we highlight the stories of the 117,000 individuals cared for at Maple Grove while preserving its beauty and tranquility for future generations.

resources.mission: We are a not-for-profit organization devoted to preserving the rich history of Richmond Hill. We promote the historic heritage of our architectural legacy and the contributions of our past and present residents through educational lectures, research, and participation in local historical events. We promote historic plaques for residences and archive records and personal collections which are available to researchers.
